title: Chaa gaya taboot pe teeroon ka badal ya khuda
body:
Chaa gaya taboot pe teeroon ka badal ya khuda .
Fatema s.a ke laal ka (x 2) teeroon me laasha chup gaya.
1) chal pada wapas janaza ya ilaahi khair ho (x 2).
Zainab o kulsoom bahar (x 2) aa na jaye be rida.
<<DIVIDER>>
2) jab chune tukde jigar ke zainab o kulsoom ne (x 2)
Zainab e kausar ko waqte karbala yaad aa gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
3) hai ajab kissa ke ek bhai ki mayyat me aqhii (x 2)
Doosre bhai ke laasha (x 2) be kafan reh jaayega.
<<DIVIDER>>
4)jab hua daakhil janaza bibiyoo ke darmiyaan (x 2)
dekh kar taboot zainab (x 2) ka jigar phatne laga.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) thi nahi bhooli shahadat murtuza ki aur phir (x 2)
choodkar ghar chal pade (x 2) hai aaj hasan e mujtaba.
<<DIVIDER>>
6)Kha gaya touqeer mere dil tu yeh armaan bhi (x 2)
mustafa (as) ke paas jaa (x 2) uska nawasa so gaya.
